title: Proposed variation to the s87B undertakings of Alinta Limited and others dated 25 October 2004

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC timeline suspended at the request of Alinta Asset Management Pty Ltd.
ACCC timeline recommenced at the request of Alinta Asset Management Pty Ltd.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC ceased its review of the proposed variation.

body_sections.Summary: Alinta Asset Management Pty Ltd (AAM), formerly Alinta Network Services Pty Ltd, submitted a draft variation to the s87B undertaking of Alinta Limited and others, which was accepted by the ACCC on 25 October 2004. The draft variation proposed to remove AAM from the undertaking, because AAM had ceased to be a party to the operating services agreement for the Dampier to Bunbury Natural Gas Pipeline. Given that the amendments proposed by the AAM Variation have been superseded by the broader variation which was accepted by the ACCC on 28 January 2010, the ACCC has ceased its review of the AAM variation.
